name: Full sprint lifecycle with constraints
description: Set up and complete a full sprint lifecycle in Project Alpha: (1) Create sprint 'Sprint 9', (2) activate it, (3) create 3 issues including a P1 'Critical payment bug', (4) add all issues to the sprint, (5) assign each to a different developer, (6) transition the P1 through the full workflow (open→in_progress→in_review→resolved→closed), (7) resolve and close the other two issues, (8) close the sprint. All issues must be resolved/closed before the sprint can close.

name: Multi-project coordination
description: Activate Project Beta. Create a sprint in both Alpha and Beta. Create a P1 'Cross-platform auth issue' in Alpha and a related P2 'Mobile auth screen' in Beta. Link the two issues. Add the 'security' label (label-security) to both. Assign the Alpha issue to Eve Park (user-dev-1) and the Beta issue to Hiro Tanaka (user-dev-4). Add a comment on each issue referencing the other.

name: Adversarial constraint gauntlet
description: Navigate a scenario full of constraints: (1) There's a locked P3 issue — unlock it and escalate to P1. (2) There's a closed sprint — you cannot add issues to it, create a new one. (3) There's an in_review issue assigned to you — you cannot self-approve, reassign it first. (4) There's an active sprint with an open P1 — you cannot close the sprint until you resolve it. Complete all four sub-tasks.

name: Project wind-down
description: Wind down Project Alpha completely: (1) Find all open/in-progress issues and close them (transition through proper workflow). (2) Close any active sprints (resolve P1 blockers first). (3) Close the project. The project has a mix of issues in various states and an active sprint with a P1.
